name: Linear Feature Decoder with Learned Color Basis
definition: A white-box decoder that replaces the nonlinear MLP used in hybrid methods. It uses a linear combination of features and a learned basis for view-dependent color, enabling adaptivity and modeling of scenes with variable appearance.
summary: This white-box linear decoder replaces black-box MLPs by using spatially-localized features as coefficients for a learned basis to describe view-dependent color and density.
